project_context.architecture_constraints: Static HTML/CSS/JS ONLY. Use Tailwind via CDN (<script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>). NO React, NO build tooling, NO Shadcn UI framework dependencies.

theme_and_archetype.reasoning: The landing page makes bold, life-or-death claims ('poor diet has overtaken smoking as the leading cause of death'). It requires absolute authority, truth, and stark contrast to agitate the problem of UPFs, leading seamlessly into the solution (the app). A deep dark theme with bright green accents matches the existing brand app icon.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none text-white
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-[#4CAF50]

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous vertical spacing to allow the narrative to breathe. Mobile-first grid collapsing.
layout_and_spacing.section_padding: py-20 md:py-32 px-4 md:px-8 max-w-7xl mx-auto

motion.philosophy: Functional and crisp. No heavy JS libraries since it is pure HTML. Use Tailwind transition classes.

components.navbar: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border-b border-white/10. Include the reconstructed Logo on left, and 'Download App' CTA on right.
components.logo_reconstruction: A flex container (rounded-xl bg-black p-2 border border-[#4CAF50]/30). Inside, small text 'YOU ARE WHAT YOU EAT' stacked, where 'YOU/WHAT/YOU' are text-white and 'ARE/EAT' are text-[#4CAF50]. Add a couple of dark green small circles as decoration to mimic the description.

buttons.primary_cta: bg-[#4CAF50] text-black font-bold text-lg rounded-full px-8 py-4 flex items-center justify-center gap-2
buttons.store_badge: bg-black border border-white/20 text-white rounded-lg px-4 py-2 flex items-center gap-3 hover:bg-white/5 transition-colors

cards.base: bg-[#171717] border border-white/10 rounded-3xl p-6 lg:p-10
cards.glass: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/5 border border-white/10 rounded-2xl p-6

components.video_embed: iframe class='w-full aspect-video rounded-2xl border border-white/10 shadow-lg'

narrative_flow: 1. HERO: Stark, high-impact headline. 'Poor diet has overtaken smoking as the leading cause of death.' App store download buttons. Dark overlay, gritty texture.
2. AGITATION (The Truth): Embed the Diary of a CEO video (dzUDhstqXbg). Big typography outlining the stats on UPF-related mortality.
3. EDUCATION: Bento grid with the other two YouTube videos (BAxkGg8nk3w, zO7tyleoxwE) explaining what UPFs actually are and why they are hidden in everyday foods.
4. SOLUTION: Introduce YAWYE app. 'You Are What You Eat'. Feature the barcode scanning image. Explain the AI health score and how it penalizes UPFs.
5. PRICING & CTA: £1.99/mo subscription. Bold, simple pricing card. Final push to download via App Store/Google Play.
6. FOOTER: Support, privacy policy, terms of service links.

accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='hero-download-btn', data-testid='nav-pricing-link').
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure white text on `#0A0A0A` and `#171717` meets APCA/WCAG standards. The green CTA button (`#4CAF50`) must have black text (`#000000`) for accessibility.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL constraints: DO NOT build a React app. DO NOT install Shadcn or npm packages. The final output must be pure static HTML files (index.html, subscribe.html, etc.) that run in a browser with zero build steps.
Use Tailwind CSS via CDN script: <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>. Configure the Tailwind object in the head to match the colors and fonts defined above.
Use HTML, regular CSS, and vanilla JS (if needed for simple mobile menu toggle).
Build the brand logo using pure HTML/CSS flexbox as instructed in components.logo_reconstruction.
Ensure the Google Ads conversion tracking remains conceptually intact (or add placeholder script tags for it).
Follow the narrative_flow exactly to build the single-page scroll journey on index.html.
